tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Compiles src/ to dist/. The admin UI components are bundled from dist/, so the web server needs a fresh build.

tasks.label: database: apply migrations and seed statuses
tasks.command: npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run seed:reference
tasks.detail: Run once after the local database is up (and after pulling new migrations).

tasks.label: create the first administrator
tasks.detail: Asks for a password in the terminal (never passed as an argument).

tasks.label: seed: create or complete the demo data
tasks.detail: 2000 tickets, 10000 comments and 200 files in the S3 bucket from .env. Safe to repeat.

tasks.label: seed: verify the demo data
tasks.detail: Counts, workflow, dates and every file in Storage. Exits with an error and lists what is wrong.

tasks.label: seed: reset (dry run, deletes nothing)
tasks.detail: Shows what a reset would remove.

tasks.label: seed: reset (delete and recreate the demo data)
tasks.detail: Removes only the demo rows and files, then creates them again. Refused in production.

tasks.label: seed: delete the demo data only
tasks.detail: Removes the demo rows and files and does not recreate them.

tasks.label: demo: migrate, seed statuses and load the demo data
dependsOn: database: apply migrations and seed statuses
seed: create or complete the demo data
tasks.detail: First-time setup of a running local database with the demo data (asks for the two passwords).

inputs.description: Password for the demo administrators (12+ characters, typed hidden, not stored)
Password for the demo agents (12+ characters, typed hidden, not stored)
Type the dataset name to confirm: takehome-demo
